mods.name: todos
mods.description: Adds /todos: TODO, FIXME and HACK lines in tracked files, found with git grep, grouped by file (50 lines at most). Read-only.

mods.name: loc
mods.description: Adds /loc: lines of tracked text files by language, read with git, sorted, with a total. Skips lockfiles and binaries. Read-only.

mods.name: hotspots
mods.description: Adds /hotspots: the 10 files changed most often in the last 90 days, from git log, with change counts. Read-only.

mods.name: commit-msg
mods.description: Adds /commit-msg: a Conventional Commits message proposed from the staged diff, read with git. Heuristic, no model call, writes nothing.

mods.name: branches
mods.description: Adds /branches: local branches merged into the default branch or idle for 30 days, as a cleanup list, read with git. Never deletes.

mods.name: repo-pack
mods.description: Five read-only repo commands in one mod: /todos, /loc, /hotspots, /commit-msg and /branches. They read git.
